summary: This Phase 3 study looks at adults with moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis, which is a long-term disease causing inflammation and sores in the large intestine, along with obesity or being overweight. Researchers want to test treatments using the drugs mirikizumab and tirzepatide compared to mirikizumab and a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the real drug. The study plans to include 350 participants who will take part for up to 61 weeks. Eli Lilly and Company is the sponsor of this Recruiting trial.
